answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 56274 Country: India Title: Dua for career Question: Can you please tell me a dua to achieve whatever I want in career, a dua which is really helpful? I want to study in abroad but due to financial conditions I cannot afford it. Please help me with a dua so that my wish is fulfilled. Answer ID: 56274 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 7/14/N=01/1436) You should recite Surah Yaseen once in the morning daily. In-shaAllah, all your needs and objects shall be fulfilled easily with its virtues. (Mishkat, p. 189, with reference Sunan Darmi) And for halal provision read the following dua extensively: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ (مشكوة شريف ص 216 بحواله سنن ترمذى وغيره) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
